name: Hammoleket
title: Manasse's Female Descendant
summary: Hammoleket (also called Moleket or Hammolechet) is a woman mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Manasseh in 1 Chronicles. She was the sister of Gilead and the daughter of Machir. She is known as the mother of Ishhod, Abiezer, and Mahlah, thus playing an important role in the family history of the tribe of Manasseh.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Manasseh's Genealogy
keyEvents.description: Hammoleket is mentioned as the sister of Gilead in the genealogy of the tribe of Manasseh. She is identified as the daughter of Machir, son of Manasseh.

keyEvents.title: Mother of Ishhod
keyEvents.description: Hammoleket gave birth to Ishhod, one of her three named sons in the genealogy.

keyEvents.title: Mother of Abiezer
keyEvents.description: Hammoleketh was the mother of Abiezer, who became the patriarch of the Abiezrite clan in the tribe of Manasseh. Gideon was a later descendant of this lineage.

keyEvents.title: Mother of Mahlah
keyEvents.description: Hammoleketh also bore Mahlah, who is mentioned among her children in the genealogical records of Chronicles.

keyEvents.title: Lineage of Machir
keyEvents.description: Hammoleketh belonged to the lineage of Machir. Machir was the firstborn son of Manasseh and a prominent figure in Israel's tribal history, known as the father of Gilead.
